text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Sending you some local specialties from my new post.
Enjoy them, and know that I'm cheering for you. From Dad."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, quite a variety here too.
Dantsu-chan's dad is such a nice person, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's right, she's always worrying about me. I'll have to thank her later.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, these cookies were recommended to me before. Look, right here~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Ohh~, looks delicious!
Then Mirako-senpai, tonight............ Ah.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, I was planning to eat it, but...
Lately, my weight has been a bit...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?
I can't see it at all, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, eating a few cookies isn't gonna change
anything! You'll be totally fine."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, it would mess with my running too...
Plus... I'm sure my dad would want to cheer on a hard-working me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, I've made up my mind!
Starting today, I'm on a diet!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Training on your own again today, Dantsu-chan?
You're really working hard on that diet, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! I just wanted to hurry and tell my dad what I thought of his souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll enjoy eating deliciously once I lose the weight!
Alright, one more lap, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Through consistent solo training, Dantsu Flame successfully pulled off her diet!
